title: QHSE Officer - Environmental Health & Safety
description:
Bring your energy to Aggreko as a **QHSE Officer – Environmental Health & Safety** to be based in our depot in **Johor, Malaysia.** This role will support the effective implementation of QHSE policies and procedures and assist in driving a safe work culture of QHSE at depot and site locations across Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore.

Power without pause. Heating, cooling and oil-free air without end. We keep our customers’ worlds on. From world-class events that last a few weeks to mining operations and remote communities who rely on us for decades.

**What you’ll do as a QHSE Officer:**

* **Implement and Ensure Compliance:** Assist in implementing QHSE policies and processes, ensuring adherence to local Malaysian legislation and Aggreko's internal standards.
* **Stakeholder Liaison:** Build and maintain effective relationships with sites and depots, addressing QHSE issues and providing expert advice to all staff levels.
* **Safe Work Practices:** Monitor and support the execution of safe work processes and ensure Safe Work Method Statements are in place across all Aggreko locations.
* **Project and Tenders:** Assist in the completion of QHSE-related aspects for project tenders.
* **Accident and Risk Management:** Leads incident investigations for Malaysia and Thailand, assist in producing safety alerts, and conduct comprehensive risk assessments.
* **Training and Induction:** Deliver QHSE training and conduct inductions for new and existing employees.
* **Rehabilitation Support:** Assist with rehabilitation and return-to-work processes.
* **Regulatory Reporting:** Handle all scheduled waste reporting to DOE and annual DOSH reporting, along with other Malaysian regulatory requirements.
* **License Management:** Support, coordinate, and maintain all QHSE-related license applications for Malaysia.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Proactively identify and implement ongoing QHSE improvements in collaboration with the HSE Specialist - Asia and provide support to the Singapore business as needed.
* Support and assist direct report HSE Specialist - Asia on any other QHSE related duties and assignment.

**What we are looking for:**

* Degree in relevant field highly preferred
* Willing to travel frequently within Malaysia states and occasional support in Thailand and Singapore to attend client meeting, multiple project site and depot etc.
* Candidate needs to have a valid driving license and own transport for Malaysia interstate travel.
* **Certified Health and Safety Professional:** Possesses certifications in Health and Safety from Malaysian DOSH/DOE/BOMBA, including OSH Coordinator, Scheduled Waste Training (CEPSVAM), and CERT/First Aid courses.
* **DOSH Certified Officer:** Holds a DOSH certified Safety and Health Officer (Green Book) qualification and registered with DOSH. Candidates who possess SSS / Yellow book and in the process of completion of Green Book Certification are also welcome to apply.
* **Registered OSH Coordinator:** Able to register as an OSH Coordinator for the Malaysia JB Depot DOSH myKKP.
* **Regulatory Reporting Expertise:** Leads and is responsible for the Depot's monthly scheduled waste reporting to DOE.
* **Strong Regulatory Knowledge:** Possesses a solid understanding of Malaysia's OSH requirements (DOSH), environmental regulations (DOE), and Fire Safety Regulations (BOMBA).
* **Auditing and Compliance Experience:** Has a solid understanding and application of local regulations and compliance, preferably as a trained system auditor with prior auditing experience.
* **ISO Standards Proficiency:** Experienced with ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 standards.
* **Strong Administrative and QHSE documentation skills:** Computer literate with MS Office proficiency, effective administrator, well-organized, methodical, and capable of working under pressure with minimal supervision.
* **Excellent Communication and Problem-Solving:** Possesses effective communication skills, strong problem-solving and analytical abilities, planning and organizing skills, and meticulous attention to detail.

**Here’s what you’ll get:**

* Competitive compensation package
* Industry-leading benefit plans
* Continuous training and development with career growth opportunities
* Safety-focused culture

Our people are can-do, positive, resilient and persistent. If that feels like you, apply now and build your career with the people bringing energy to the world.

[#LI-KS1]

**Equal employment opportunity**

We welcome people from different backgrounds and cultures, and respect people’s unique skills, attitudes and experiences. We encourage everyone to be themselves at work because we know that’s how we do our best, for each other, for our customers, for the communities where we work, and for our careers.

We are an equal opportunity employer. If you apply for a role at Aggreko, we will consider your application based on your qualifications and experience, and not on your race, colour, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Research Fellow (Genetics/Environmental Science/Biological Sciences)
description:
The Asian School of the Environment (ASE) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) is an interdisciplinary school focusing on the connections between geosciences, ecology, society and Earth systems. Our approach integrates these disciplines to examine big hazards and environmental challenges both in Southeast Asia and globally. We conduct cutting-edge research on topics that include geohazards, climate change, sea-level rise, environmental sustainability, conservation of environment and biodiversity, and interactions between environment and society.

  

For more details, please view https://www.ntu.edu.sg/ase .

  

We are seeking a motivated and organised Research Fellow to support research activities, coordinate collaborative projects, and laboratory operations. The successful candidate will conduct research while playing a central role in project planning, coordination across research teams and collaborators, and the development of future research directions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Conduct research aligned with the group’s research programmes, contributing to study design, data analysis, and scientific publications.
* Coordinate research projects, monitor progress against milestones, and support the timely delivery of project outcomes.
* Facilitate collaboration across projects, research teams, and external partners through regular communication, meetings, and follow-up activities.
* Manage day-to-day laboratory operations, including procurement, inventory, equipment maintenance, and compliance with institutional safety requirements.
* Coordinate project logistics, including sample collection and transport, permits, and research-related travel.
* Support the preparation of research reports, presentations, grant proposals, and other project documentation.
* Contribute to future research planning by identifying priorities, developing project plans, and exploring funding and collaboration opportunities.
Support and mentor students and research staff in research activities and laboratory practices.  

  

**Job Requirements:**

  

* A PhD in genetics, environmental science, biological sciences, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated research experience and the ability to contribute independently to scientific projects and publications.
* Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in laboratory operations and research logistics.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse collaborators.
A proactive and collaborative approach, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.  

  

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

description:
Sustainability Data Analyst Intern

**Scientific Climate Ratings** (an EDHEC venture) | **Location:** Singapore (on-site) | **Duration:** 3 to 6 months, full-time | **Start date:** 2027|

  
  

Scientific Climate Ratings brings climate risk data and ratings to investors. As physical and transition risks increasingly affect investment portfolios and corporate balance sheets, investors need high-quality climate risk data and assessment tools. Join our growing global team and help build them.

As a Sustainability Data Analyst Intern, you will collect, process and analyse sustainability data for infrastructure assets such as power plants and airports. You will gain hands-on experience in data extraction, carbon emissions analysis and geospatial analysis, and you can shape part of the internship around your own interests.

  
  

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Data collection & cleaning:** Extract, verify, clean and structure sustainability data from company and asset reports, ensuring it is accurate and consistent.
* **Asset data for emissions modelling:** Identify and extract asset-specific data (e.g. for power plants or airports) used in our carbon emissions models.
* **Geospatial analysis:** Use QGIS or ArcGIS to map, extract and check the boundaries of assets.
* **Research & case studies (based on your interests):** Contribute to research projects on climate risk assessment and financial materiality.

**Who we're looking for**
=========================

**Must have**
-------------

* Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate programme in a relevant field, such as environmental science, geography, engineering, finance, economics or data science
* A strong interest in sustainability, climate risk and infrastructure
* Close attention to detail and accuracy when handling data
* Comfort reading and extracting information from annual and sustainability reports
* Ability to work independently and eagerness to learn new skills

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Basic Python for data processing and analysis
* Experience with geospatial data and tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS

**What you'll gain**
====================

* Practical experience in sustainability data analysis and climate risk research
* Hands-on exposure to geospatial analysis and carbon emissions modelling
* The chance to contribute to a new climate ratings business backed by EDHEC's research expertise

**How to apply**
================

Send your CV and a short statement of interest in pdf format with the subject line "Sustainability Data Analyst Intern – [Your Name]".

  
  

**About us**
============

Scientific Climate Ratings is an EDHEC Business School venture that brings EDHEC's research-driven data and ratings on climate risk to investors. It follows EDHEC's track record of building successful financial analytics businesses, including Scientific Beta (acquired by Singapore Exchange in 2020), Scientific Portfolio, and Scientific Infra & Private Assets, an ESMA-regulated provider of private asset data and analytics.
